Page(

    appBar: PizzaHeader(),

    Button(label: "BACK", style: ButtonStyle.ghost, icon: Icons.chevronLeft, onTap: Navigate(to: Route.menu)),
    If(condition: product != null, then: Column(gap: Space.lg, children: [
      Stack(children: [
        Image(src: product.image_url, alt: product.name, aspectRatio: 1.6, radius: Radius.lg),
        Positioned(top: 12, right: 12, child: Box(padding: Insets(x: 12, y: 6), radius: Radius.full, background: Color.primary, child: Text(child: formatMoney(product.display_price_cents), weight: FontWeight.bold, color: Color.primaryInk)))
      ]),
      Text(child: product.name, size: FontSize.xxl, weight: FontWeight.bold, letterSpacing: 1, lineHeight: 1),
      Text(child: product.description, color: Color.textMuted),
      ForEach(items: choices.groups, as: "group", child: Box(padding: Space.lg, radius: Radius.lg, background: group.depth > 0 ? Color.surfaceAlt : Color.surface, child: Column(gap: Space.md, children: [
        Row(gap: Space.sm, children: [Expanded(child: Text(child: group.label, size: FontSize.sm, weight: FontWeight.bold, letterSpacing: 2, color: Color.primary)), Text(child: group.required ? "MUST PICK" : group.single ? "Choose one" : "Up to ${group.max}", size: FontSize.xs, weight: FontWeight.bold, color: Color.warning)]),
        Grid(cols: 2, gap: Space.sm, children: [ForEach(items: group.choices, as: "choice", child: Box(padding: Space.md, radius: Radius.md, background: choice.selected ? Color.primary : Color.surfaceAlt, onTap: ToggleOption(group: group.id, choice: choice.id), ariaLabel: choice.label, child: Column(gap: Space.xs, children: [Text(child: choice.label, weight: FontWeight.bold, color: choice.selected ? "+ ${formatMoney(choice.price_cents)}" : "Included", size: FontSize.xs, color: choice.selected ? Color.primaryInk : Color.textMuted)])))])
      ]))),
      Row(gap: Space.md, crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.center, children: [
        Box(width: 52, height: 52, radius: Radius.md, alignment: Anchor.center, background: Color.surfaceAlt, onTap: SetState(state: "quantity", value: state.quantity > 1 ? state.quantity - 1 : 1), ariaLabel: "Fewer", child: Icon(name: Icons.minus)),
        Expanded(child: Text(child: state.quantity, size: FontSize.xxl, weight: FontWeight.bold, align: TextAlign.center)),
        Box(width: 52, height: 52, radius: Radius.md, alignment: Anchor.center, background: Color.primary, onTap: SetState(state: "quantity", value: state.quantity + 1), ariaLabel: "More", child: Icon(name: Icons.plus, color: Color.primaryInk))
      ]),
      If(condition: product.is_available, then: Box(onTap: AddConfiguredProduct(quantity: state.quantity), ariaLabel: "Add to cart", child: Box(padding: Insets(x: 18, y: 16), radius: Radius.lg, gradient: Gradient(from: Color.primary, to: Color.warning, begin: Anchor.left, end: Anchor.right), child: Row(mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween, crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.center, children: [Text(child: "ADD TO CART", weight: FontWeight.bold, letterSpacing: 2, color: Color.primaryInk), Text(child: formatMoney((product.display_price_cents + choices.addon_price_cents) * state.quantity), weight: FontWeight.bold, color: Color.primaryInk)]))), else: Text(child: "SOLD OUT", weight: FontWeight.bold, color: Color.danger))
    ]), else: Text(child: "PICK SOMETHING FROM THE MENU.", weight: FontWeight.bold))
  ])])),
  )
